The '''Yetoom system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yetoom Na Uun]].
